steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: These organisations are motivated by Jesus' teaching to care for the poor and the parable of the Good Samaritan. They work regardless of the religion of the people they help — reflecting Christian love for all people, not just Christians.

steps.title: RS Exam Tips — The Worldwide Church
steps.body: 1. For The Worldwide Church questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Worldwide Church to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Explain two ways the worldwide Church works for reconciliation. | "Christian aid organisations should only help Christians." Evaluate this statement.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always refer to specific sources of authority (scripture, sacred texts, religious leaders) Explain contrasting beliefs — different views within and between traditions Use key terminology precisely (e.g. tawhid, atonement, sanctity of life) For 12-mark evaluation questions, consider both sides before reaching a justified conclusion Link beliefs to their impact on individuals, communities and society Acknowledge diversity — no religious tradition has a single, uniform view
